status_policy: This is a release control ledger layered over REQUIREMENT_LEDGER.v1.json. VERIFIED requires reproducible evidence; a missing live input or protected promotion remains EXTERNAL_BLOCKED.

requirements.title: Bounded CFB/NFL release scope
requirements.gate: Only CFB/NFL operate; all other league routes fail closed.

requirements.title: One canonical engine
requirements.gate: Fresh installation resolves only canonical src/dcm runtime.

requirements.title: Private input boundary
requirements.gate: No raw HAR, cookie, credential, response body, or run DB in Git/output.

requirements.title: Native runtime
requirements.gate: 6.1 uses self-contained runtime; legacy replay fails closed when bytes are absent.

requirements.title: Typed host runner
requirements.gate: dcm-host run emits schema-versioned receipt for CFB and NFL.

requirements.title: Full-board accounting
requirements.gate: Every offer has a terminal disposition before exclusions.

requirements.title: HAR/platform offer authority
requirements.gate: Offer line/side/market/status resolve from platform authority or fail closed.

requirements.title: League-aware external research
requirements.gate: CFB and NFL source routing is explicit, typed, and test-covered.

requirements.title: Typed evidence provenance
requirements.gate: Evidence includes authority, source key, cutoff, hash, and failure state.

requirements.title: Reuse and resume
requirements.gate: Content-addressed reuse and idempotent restart are observable.

requirements.title: CFB operational acceptance
requirements.gate: Current private HAR and host evidence yield a redacted local receipt.

requirements.title: NFL operational acceptance
requirements.gate: Current private HAR and host evidence yield a redacted local receipt.

requirements.title: Conserved model path
requirements.gate: Model output links to evidence, parameter, event-world, and algorithm plans.

requirements.title: No forced selection
requirements.gate: Ineligible/uncertain rows hold; only PLAYABLE_CANDIDATE enters portfolio path.

requirements.title: Freeze firewall
requirements.gate: Frozen output is immutable and evidence-linked.

requirements.title: Future-only settlement
requirements.gate: Settlement/learning is append-only, chronological, and separate from forecast.

requirements.title: Failure-path coverage
requirements.gate: Missing side, source failure, stale/conflict, unsupported league tests pass.

requirements.title: Clean CI and benchmark
requirements.gate: Fresh-install, targeted, full-suite, policy, inventory, and representative benchmark pass.

requirements.title: Protected promotion
requirements.gate: Normal PR review/checks, remote readback, and no direct main write.

requirements.title: Honest 6.1 release receipt
requirements.gate: Versioned receipt distinguishes software, operational, predictive, and root states.
